# Assessment overview

Supplementary application analysis for Photo Album. These documents describe the
existing implementation; recommendations do not indicate implemented changes.

| Document | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Application components, deployment boundaries, and relationships. |
| [Dependency map](dependency-map.md) | Maven dependencies, framework relationships, and external services. |
| [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | HTTP routes, request and response contracts, and communication sequences. |
| [Data architecture](data-architecture.md) | Persistence model, database BLOB storage, and data lifecycle. |
| [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Externalized settings, environment variables, and environment differences. |
| [Business workflows](business-workflows.md) | Upload, gallery, retrieval, and deletion workflows with sequence diagrams. |
